basis: Registered retrospectively under AFC-195, the fence. Commit 65e7631 landed this suite under AFC-193 before the claim registry existed. ADR-0002 finding F2 is the subject; the suite is the assertion whose absence let F2 ship, and it also pins the worker's grant surface to exactly {run, sync_clocks} in both directions. Author is the CTO, which is who git already records.

doesNotClaim: A claim asserts authorship, not correctness. tests/db/64 still reports as an R2 violation under --check-commit and this file does not suppress that.
